This might be a long shot, but is anyone here from or has visited Johnson City, TN? 

The city is giving the public very little time to voice their opinion on data center regulations. 

Please help me prevent a data center from being built in 5 minutes away from my home: tinyurl.com/bdcv7vwe
I said energy crisis — not oil crisis. This war is impacting the price of all fossil fuels, and recent battery installations have helped Australia reduce their dependence on natural gas.

All hope is not lost when it comes to protecting our planet! 

Read more in the latest edition of Good Climate News: open.substack.com/pub/goodclim...
Good Climate News is officially the 36th top selling climate & environment publication on Substack! Thank y'all for your endless support. I'm having a blast writing this newsletter!

Big Tech and Big Oil have partnered up to keep the era of fossil fuels alive by building massive data centers and choosing to power them with fossil fuels instead of clean energy.

Remember that the next time you use generative AI because the article below is from 2024.
GOOD NEWS: Yesterday the United Nations voted 141-8 to adopt a resolution brought forward by Vanuatu saying that countries have a legal obligation to address climate change.
Paris is proving that cities can quickly reverse their car dependency!

Even though we need more rooftop + parking lot solar, it alone won't be enough to power the world. That's why we need to use all the clean energy solutions available to us in the ways, places, and scales that make the most sense for each area. In some places, that includes rural solar farms!

Of course, there needs to be better regulation to ensure habitat isn't destroyed when building solar farms, but my colleagues aren't sharing that nuance. They're saying that all rural solar is bad without even mentioning there are solutions.

Plus, leasing to solar developers can help farmers and other rural landowners keep their property instead of selling it to a data center developer or home builder! Far too many landowners have no choice but to sell because of finances. Solar (and wind) really can help them keep their land.

Some of my climate media colleagues are suddenly hating on solar in rural areas without realizing it's the newest fossil fuel disinformation talking point aimed at getting landowners to stop leasing their land to solar developers.

Y'all, we need solar EVERYWHERE.

I recently got an induction-friendly gooseneck kettle, and I’m constantly amazed at how quickly I can boil water for my tea. Mine isn’t nearly as powerful as this stove, but I can still boil a full kettle in under 1.5 minutes!
I thought we could all use a little pep talk because the doomscroll keeps getting worse 😮‍💨😅

A 136 MW solar farm recently began generating electricity in Zambia — making it the largest in the country to date, but it won’t hold that record for long considering the government just signed a deal to build another one that will generate 2.5x more power.

I straight up got blacklisted by the Biden White House for campaigning against the Mountain Valley Pipeline and the Willow Project. They even set up a meeting between me and one of their climate advisors to get me to stop calling them out. I refused, and the Dems haven’t worked with me since!

Plug-in solar has been rapidly growing across the globe in recent years, so it makes sense it’s finally coming to the United States!

Read more: www.canarymedia.com/articles/sol...

Please stop telling scientists they’re wrong about it not being too late to address climate change and go use that energy to do some climate activism instead because we’re stalling progress by continually having this debate.

⚠️ Johnson City, TN ⚠️ Fill out the data center regulation survey at the link in bio and below then make plans to vote in the upcoming elections in August and November for candidates who don’t support data centers. https://cojctn.wufoo.com/forms/q14lbsgz13tezj8/?utm_source=ig&utm_medium=social&utm_content=link_in_bio&fbclid=PAdGRleAR-qXZleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA8xMjQwMjQ1NzQyODc0MTQAAacMn8ZoGvD-7G6suBDI2aBVmoYoB7ITAScnDS29B3_Pm0NJWauHR7ajHVkjRg_aem_aOxG5IVhJObN9tDP__LXbg #johnsoncitytn #jo
